CREATE TABLE "public"."conversation" (
  "agentLastReadSeq" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "assigneeId" uuid,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "firstAgentReplyAt" timestamptz,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "lastAssigneeId" uuid,
  "lastMessageAt" timestamptz,
  "lastMessagePreview" text,
  "lastSeq" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "resolvedAt" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'unassigned' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "visitorId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "visitorLastReadSeq" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "workspaceId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "conversation_status_check_b9fdd56b" CHECK ("status" IN ('unassigned', 'assigned', 'resolved'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."invitation" (
  "acceptedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "invitedById" uuid NOT NULL,
  "tokenHash" text NOT NULL,
  "workspaceId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."member" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "passwordHash" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'agent' NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "workspaceId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "member_role_check_b3266c03" CHECK ("role" IN ('admin', 'agent')),
  CONSTRAINT "member_status_check_83a17ead" CHECK ("status" IN ('active', 'removed'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."message" (
  "body" text NOT NULL,
  "clientMessageId" text NOT NULL,
  "conversationId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "senderMemberId" uuid,
  "senderType" text NOT NULL,
  "seq" int4 NOT NULL,
  "workspaceId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "message_body_len_d02407bd" CHECK (char_length(body) BETWEEN 1 AND 4000),
  CONSTRAINT "message_senderType_check_667d540d" CHECK ("senderType" IN ('visitor', 'agent', 'system'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."note" (
  "authorId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "body" text NOT NULL,
  "conversationId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "workspaceId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."savedReply" (
  "body" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdById" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "shortcut" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "workspaceId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."session" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "memberId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "prevRefreshJti" text,
  "refreshJti" text NOT NULL,
  "rotatedAt" timestamptz,
  "userAgent" text,
  "workspaceId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."visitor" (
  "displayNo" int4 NOT NULL,
  "email" text,
  "firstSeenAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "lastPageUrl" text,
  "lastSeenAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "name" text,
  "workspaceId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."workspace" (
  "awayMessage" text DEFAULT 'We''re away right now — leave your email and we''ll reply.' NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "demoExpiresAt" timestamptz,
  "greeting" text DEFAULT 'Hi, how can we help?' NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "isDemo" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "publicKey" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "widgetColor" text DEFAULT '#4F46E5' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
